Coram : P. SATHASIVAM*, B.S. CHAUHAN
Penal Code, 1860 - s.376: c Rape - Conviction - Challenged on the ground of inordinate delay in lodging the FIR - Held: Challenge not tenable since the delay was satisfactorily explained - The delay occurred because of the intervention of the village Panchayat which tried to bring about a investigative machinery only after the Panchayat disagreed to impose fine and punishment as suggested by him on the accused.
